design: Paired, two-arm, six-task, blinded decision quality comparison. No outcome-generating trial has been run.
condition_difference: Graph arm may inspect frozen typed claims-v1.json; flat arm receives the same underlying sources as a chronological list without typed relationships.
primary_endpoint: Number of tasks identifying a decisive scientifically correct next test with exact acceptance criterion under equal budget; judged blinded.

tasks.prompt: Specify the most decisive exact test for the missing short-vector span-count premise, with the precise field and failure event; state which current downstream identities survive.
Select the smallest reproducible small-field rank experiment that could distinguish a Frobenius-lift rank defect from the fourth-root symmetry ambiguity; define seeds and exact pass/fail.
Choose the first exact subspace coupling inequality needed to extend the six-qutrit source-conditional certificate beyond its encoded witness class; specify the unproven margin.
Identify the strongest single falsification check to perform before public promotion of the 25-copy certificate, separating exact downstream arithmetic from inherited source assumptions.
Choose a precise rank-doubling and scale-window experiment testing whether block-diagonal positivity margins dominate off-block operator couplings, with a numerical failure condition.
For a finite-to-infinite positivity claim, identify an explicit sufficient block condition and the mathematical obstruction preventing promotion without uniform tail control.
